title: 新加坡裕廊岩洞~Jurong Rock Caverns
focus: 岩洞楔體、水力封存與產品庫存~Cavern wedges, hydraulic containment and product inventory
summary: JTC公開介紹裕廊岩洞可儲存147萬立方公尺液態碳氫產品，並將地下深度與海床下深度分開；2014年開幕有總理公署紀錄。本課從土地介面、岩體節理與支護開始，進入水力封存、產品庫存及監測交付。幾何面積、局部壓差和假想庫存都不等於實際土地效益或操作上限。~JTC describes 1.47 million cubic metres of liquid-hydrocarbon storage and distinguishes depth below ground from depth beneath the seabed; the PMO records the 2014 opening. The course moves from land interfaces and jointed rock to support, hydraulic containment, inventory and monitoring. Geometric area, local pressure difference and hypothetical inventory are not actual land savings or operating limits.

units.anchor: 幾何等效面積~Geometric equivalent area
units.title: 地下儲存與地面介面~Subsurface storage and surface interfaces
units.mechanism: 裕廊以地下儲存重新配置地面用途，教材容積除高度只算假想幾何面積，不重述為實際節省土地。地下儲存可以重新分配地面用途，但洞室幾何投影不等於實際釋出的土地。出入口、消防、產品管線、地面製程與維修空間仍占用土地；將容量換算成等效面積只是一個比較基準，須保持高度、利用率和附屬設施範圍一致。~Jurong reallocates surface use through underground storage; volume divided by height gives a hypothetical geometric area, not actual land released. Underground storage changes how surface land is used, but cavern projection is not the actual land released. Access, firefighting, product pipelines, surface processing and maintenance still require space. Converting volume to an equivalent area provides a comparison metric only when height, utilisation and auxiliary-facility boundaries remain consistent.
units.model: 原創教學假設：儲存容積=100000 m³；等效高度=20 m。A=V/H=5000 m²。僅把等效高度增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為4545.45 m²。邊界：假想等斷面平面面積，不是實際節省的地面土地；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: storage volume=100000 m³; equivalent height=20 m. A=V/H=5000 m². Increasing only equivalent height by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 4545.45 m². Boundary: Hypothetical uniform-section plan area, not actual surface land saving. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 總配置另列豎井、管線、消防及地面製程空間。把洞室、豎井與地面設施分層繪圖，核對容積與占地邊界，分別列幾何面積和實際可使用土地。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~The overall layout separately includes shafts, pipelines, firefighting and surface processing. Map caverns, shafts and surface facilities separately, reconcile volume and footprint boundaries and distinguish geometric area from usable land. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 只算洞室投影會漏掉支援營運必需的地面設施。只用容積除高度宣稱節省土地會漏掉必要配套，可能低估地面通道、維修和消防的空間需求。~Cavern projection alone omits surface facilities needed for operation. Claiming land saving from volume divided by height omits essential facilities and understates access, maintenance and firefighting space.
units.misconception: 地下容積除高度就是工程實際節省的地面土地。~Underground volume divided by height equals actual surface land saved.
units.practice: 本案「幾何等效面積」的交付需回答：總配置另列豎井、管線、消防及地面製程空間。比較方案時固定功能與配套範圍，將幾何指標標為假設，土地效益由完整總配置與營運需求判讀。~For Jurong Rock Caverns, the geometric equivalent area handover must address the following evidence: The overall layout separately includes shafts, pipelines, firefighting and surface processing. Fix function and auxiliary scope when comparing options, label geometric metrics as assumptions and assess land benefit from the full layout and operational requirements.

units.anchor: 楔體重力分擔~Wedge self-weight sharing
units.title: 岩洞節理楔體與錨固~Cavern wedges and anchorage
units.mechanism: 裕廊大跨洞室的局部楔體由節理交線控制，教材自重均分不代表所有錨桿實際同時受力。大跨岩洞的局部穩定常由節理交線形成的可動楔體控制，完整岩石強度高仍可能產生重力掉塊。均分重量只估計錨固受力量級，滑移方向、節理水壓、錨桿角度與黏結長度須另驗，不能假設所有構件同時等量受力。~Joint intersections control local wedges in wide caverns; equal weight sharing does not imply simultaneous equal anchor loading. Local stability of a wide cavern can be governed by removable wedges formed by joint intersections even when intact rock is strong. Equal weight sharing estimates anchorage force scale only. Sliding direction, joint pressure, anchor inclination and bond length require separate checks, and simultaneous equal mobilisation of every anchor cannot be assumed.
units.model: 原創教學假設：岩塊體積=36 m³；岩體單位重=26 kN/m³；分擔構件數=6 個。T=γV/N=156 kN/anchor。僅把岩塊體積增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為171.6 kN/anchor。邊界：僅自重均分量級，未含節理滑移、錨角及設計係數；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: block volume=36 m³; unit weight=26 kN/m³; sharing anchors=6 count. T=γV/N=156 kN/anchor. Increasing only block volume by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 171.6 kN/anchor. Boundary: Equal self-weight sharing only, excluding sliding, anchor angle and design factors. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 以三維節理測繪及錨固試驗確認滑移方向和有效長度。由掌子面和洞頂節理測繪重建三維塊體，配合錨桿試驗與伸長量檢查受力方向和有效錨固區。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Use three-dimensional mapping and anchor tests to check sliding direction and effective length. Reconstruct three-dimensional blocks from face and roof mapping, combining anchor tests and extension measurements to check force direction and effective bonded zones. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 錨桿穿過塊體但未超出滑面可能無法提供預期拘束。節理延伸到錨固端後方可能使錨桿連同塊體移動，材料拉力試驗合格也不能證明岩體黏結可靠。~An anchor that does not extend beyond the release surface cannot provide expected restraint. A joint behind the bonded zone can let anchor and block move together; passing steel tension tests does not prove reliable rock bond.
units.misconception: 錨桿鋼材強度足夠就能排除岩洞楔體掉落。~Adequate anchor steel strength excludes cavern wedge falls.
units.practice: 本案「楔體重力分擔」的交付需回答：以三維節理測繪及錨固試驗確認滑移方向和有效長度。錨固圖與三維節理模型連結，標示試驗代表性及未知延伸，幾何改變後由岩力設計者重驗失穩模式。~For Jurong Rock Caverns, the wedge self-weight sharing handover must address the following evidence: Use three-dimensional mapping and anchor tests to check sliding direction and effective length. Link anchorage drawings to the three-dimensional joint model, state test representativeness and uncertain persistence, and reassess mechanisms when geometry changes.

units.anchor: 洞壁切向應力~Tangential wall stress
units.title: 覆土應力與洞壁重分配~Cover stress and wall redistribution
units.mechanism: 洞室群互相影響岩柱和洞頂應力，教材圓孔彈性解只是量級，不能取代非圓大跨群洞模型。開挖使岩體洞壁失去徑向拘束，遠場荷載轉移到周圍岩體，局部切向應力可能升高。圓孔彈性解可辨識量級，但節理、非圓斷面、塑性區與原位應力比會改變峰值位置，不能只用覆土重量推定全部三維應力。~Cavern groups interact through pillars and roofs; a circular-hole elastic solution is only a scale estimate, not a wide noncircular group model. Excavation removes radial confinement at the wall and transfers load through the surrounding rock, potentially raising local tangential stress. An elastic circular-hole solution identifies scale, but joints, noncircular geometry, yielding and the in-situ stress ratio alter the peak location. Cover weight alone cannot establish the complete three-dimensional stress state or support demand.
units.model: 原創教學假設：覆土深度=120 m；岩體單位重=26 kN/m³。σθ,max=3γH/1000=9.36 MPa。僅把覆土深度增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為10.296 MPa。邊界：無支承彈性圓孔，僅垂直遠場壓縮且水平遠場應力為零時，側壁最大環向壓應力；不是任意位置應力或完整三維原位解；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: cover=120 m; rock unit weight=26 kN/m³. σθ,max=3γH/1000=9.36 MPa. Increasing only cover by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 10.296 MPa. Boundary: Maximum tangential compression at the sidewalls of an unsupported elastic circular hole under vertical uniaxial remote loading with zero horizontal remote stress; not stress at any point or the complete three-dimensional in-situ state. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 比較洞頂與岩柱位移方向，核對原位應力比。將原位應力量測、岩石試驗及洞壁破壞方位相互比較，再用多點伸長計檢查變形是否與所假設應力方向一致。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Compare roof and pillar movement directions with in-situ stress ratio. Compare in-situ stress measurements, rock tests and wall-damage orientation, then use multipoint extensometers to test consistency with the assumed stress directions. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 把每洞視為孤立圓孔會漏掉岩柱荷載重分配。把彈性峰值直接當岩體強度可能誤判支護需求；相反地忽略剝落或擠壓也會讓局部破壞逐步侵入淨空。~Treating each cavern as an isolated circle omits pillar load redistribution. Equating an elastic peak with rock-mass strength misjudges support demand; overlooking spalling or squeezing lets damage progressively consume clearance.
units.misconception: 知道覆土深度就能唯一決定洞壁各方向的應力。~Cover depth uniquely determines wall stress in every direction.
units.practice: 本案「洞壁切向應力」的交付需回答：比較洞頂與岩柱位移方向，核對原位應力比。保留應力模型的座標、邊界和材料假設，量測與預測不符時先核對代表性，再由岩力設計者選擇非線性或節理模型。~For Jurong Rock Caverns, the tangential wall stress handover must address the following evidence: Compare roof and pillar movement directions with in-situ stress ratio. Record stress-model coordinates, boundaries and material assumptions; when observations disagree, check representativeness before the rock designer selects nonlinear or jointed models.

units.anchor: 支護安裝時點~Support activation time
units.title: 支護啟動與變形容量~Support activation and deformation capacity
units.mechanism: 大跨岩洞支護需隨分層開挖啟動，教材將洞頂先期支護和側壁後續釋放分開。支護荷載由開挖釋放量和支護啟動時間共同決定，越早安裝不一定讓構件受力越小。地盤反力與支護曲線必須連同掌子面距離及封閉順序理解；擠壓性地層還需保留變形容量，不能只追求高剛度與高材料強度。~Support activates during staged cavern excavation; distinguish early roof support from later sidewall release. Support load depends on stress release and activation time, so earlier installation does not necessarily reduce member forces. Interpret ground-reaction and support curves together with distance from the face and closure sequence. Squeezing ground also needs deformation capacity; high stiffness and material strength alone do not guarantee a compatible support response.
units.model: 原創教學假設：局部剛度=54 kN/mm；位移=8 mm。F=ku=432 kN。僅把位移增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為475.2 kN。邊界：線性局部彈簧，不含屈服或時間效應；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: local stiffness=54 kN/mm; movement=8 mm. F=ku=432 kN. Increasing only movement by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 475.2 kN. Boundary: Local linear spring without yielding or time effects. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 將各層開挖時間、錨荷重及伸長量同步記錄。同步記錄收斂、支護荷重與安裝里程，比較同一地質分區內的速率及荷載，不將不同開挖齡期讀值直接混合。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Synchronise excavation stages, anchor loads and extension measurements. Synchronise convergence, support loads and installation chainage; compare rates and loads within one ground domain without mixing readings at different excavation ages. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 早期洞頂穩定不能證明後續下挖不會改變其受力。過晚封閉會讓不可回復變形增加，過硬且行程不足的支護也可能脆裂，兩者都可能表現為裂縫而需不同處理。~Early roof stability does not establish unchanged loads during subsequent benching. Late closure increases irreversible movement, while excessively stiff support with little travel can fail brittly; both produce cracks but require different diagnoses.
units.misconception: 支護越厚越硬就一定能解決所有擠壓性地層。~Thicker and stiffer support necessarily solves every squeezing-ground problem.
units.practice: 本案「支護安裝時點」的交付需回答：將各層開挖時間、錨荷重及伸長量同步記錄。把安裝時間和量測資料一起交付支護設計者，任何級別變更都需地質及位移證據，不能憑單一瞬間讀值自行改支護。~For Jurong Rock Caverns, the support activation time handover must address the following evidence: Synchronise excavation stages, anchor loads and extension measurements. Submit installation times with measurements to the support designer; class changes need both ground and movement evidence, not an isolated instantaneous reading.

units.title: 測壓水頭與襯砌外壓~Piezometric head and lining pressure
units.mechanism: 周圍地下水是儲存封存分析的重要邊界，裕廊教材區分施工降水與儲存期間所需水頭。水壓取決於連通含水層的測壓水頭，不必等於地表或海面至洞頂的幾何深度。排水降低水壓卻可能增加有效應力與沉陷；停泵或排水堵塞後水頭又會回升，因此防水、排水及環境保水是互相制約的設計選擇。~Surrounding groundwater is a containment boundary; distinguish construction dewatering from heads needed during storage. Water pressure follows piezometric head in the connected aquifer, not automatically the geometric depth below ground or sea level. Drainage reduces pressure but can increase effective stress and settlement. Head may recover after a pump outage or blockage, coupling waterproofing, drainage capacity and preservation of surrounding groundwater in the permanent design.
units.model: 原創教學假設：水密度=1000 kg/m³；水頭=130 m。p=ρgh/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=1275.3 kPa。僅把水頭增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為1402.83 kPa。邊界：靜水表壓，不是土體總壓或原位量測；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: water density=1000 kg/m³; head=130 m. p=ρgh/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=1275.3 kPa. Increasing only head by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 1402.83 kPa. Boundary: Hydrostatic gauge pressure, not total earth pressure or an in-situ measurement. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 比較停抽後水頭回復與多位置測壓分布。使用分層測壓管及流量計，配合降雨或潮位序列分辨補注與設備影響，將讀值統一換算至同一高程基準。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Compare recovery after pumping stops with spatial head distribution. Use nested piezometers and flowmeters with rainfall or tide histories to distinguish recharge from equipment effects, converting observations to a common elevation datum. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 施工期越乾燥不代表儲存期封存條件越好。將暫時降水後的低水頭當成永久狀態，會漏掉停泵後外壓回升；過度排水也可能引起周邊地層壓密。~Drier construction conditions do not necessarily improve storage containment. Treating temporarily lowered head as permanent misses pressure recovery after outage; excessive drainage can also consolidate surrounding ground.
units.misconception: 目前沒有可見漏水就能在設計中忽略外水壓。~No visible leakage means that external water pressure can be omitted from design.
units.practice: 本案「測壓水頭」的交付需回答：比較停抽後水頭回復與多位置測壓分布。設計檢核應分列正常排水、堵塞與停電水位，將環境受體的容許變化和監測責任一起交付，不把抽水量當唯一指標。~For Jurong Rock Caverns, the piezometric head handover must address the following evidence: Compare recovery after pumping stops with spatial head distribution. Separate normal drainage, blocked-drain and power-outage heads and hand over receptor limits and monitoring responsibility together rather than using pump flow as the sole indicator.

units.anchor: 局部向內壓差~Local inward pressure difference
units.title: 水力封存與共同高程~Hydraulic containment at a common datum
units.mechanism: 產品液柱與氣相表壓共同決定洞壁內壓，教材全部壓力換算至同一高程再判斷局部向內梯度。岩洞液體儲存可利用周圍地下水壓維持向洞內的水力梯度，但產品液柱、氣相壓力和不同高程都影響壓差。單一測點正壓差不證明整座岩洞封存；裂隙連通、操作水位、瞬變及水幕補注的空間分布須共同驗證。~Product head and gas gauge pressure jointly determine internal pressure; convert all terms to one elevation before judging a local inward gradient. Liquid storage in rock can use surrounding groundwater pressure to maintain an inward hydraulic gradient, but product head, gas pressure and elevation affect the difference. A positive value at one point does not prove containment of the entire cavern. Fracture connectivity, operating levels, transients and the spatial distribution of water replenishment require joint assessment.
units.model: 原創教學假設：外側水密度=1000 kg/m³；外側水頭=40 m；產品密度=800 kg/m³；產品液柱=25 m；氣相表壓=20 kPa。Δp=(ρwghw−ρpghp)/1000−pgas, g=9.81 m/s²=176.2 kPa。僅把外側水頭增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為215.44 kPa。邊界：同一高程假想靜壓差，正值只顯示局部向內梯度，不證明全洞室封存；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: external water density=1000 kg/m³; external head=40 m; product density=800 kg/m³; product head=25 m; gas gauge pressure=20 kPa. Δp=(ρwghw−ρpghp)/1000−pgas, g=9.81 m/s²=176.2 kPa. Increasing only external head by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 215.44 kPa. Boundary: Hypothetical pressure difference at one elevation; positive means local inward gradient, not whole-cavern containment. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 同時核對外水頭、產品液位、密度和氣相壓力。將外側測壓、產品液位與氣壓換到同一高程和壓力基準，沿洞頂與側牆多點比較並觀察時間變化。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Check external head, product level, density and gas pressure simultaneously. Convert external head, product level and gas pressure to one elevation and pressure reference, comparing multiple roof and wall locations over time. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 漏掉氣相壓力會高估封存餘量，單點正值也不能證明全洞。漏計氣相表壓會高估向內梯度，低水頭裂隙即使離主要測點不遠也可能形成局部向外路徑。~Omitted gas pressure overstates margin, and one positive point cannot prove whole-cavern containment. Omitting gas gauge pressure overstates inward gradient; a low-head fracture near a main sensor can still create a local outward path.
units.misconception: 一支測壓管的向內壓差為正就能證明全洞室封存。~Positive inward pressure at one piezometer proves whole-cavern containment.
units.practice: 本案「局部向內壓差」的交付需回答：同時核對外水頭、產品液位、密度和氣相壓力。封存評估交付共同高程壓力圖、裂隙模型與操作範圍，監測和水力試驗互驗，不能以單一靜壓式核准操作。~For Jurong Rock Caverns, the local inward pressure difference handover must address the following evidence: Check external head, product level, density and gas pressure simultaneously. Containment assessment includes common-datum pressure maps, fracture models and operating bounds; monitoring and hydraulic tests corroborate each other beyond one static equation.

units.anchor: 可用庫存空間~Available inventory space
units.title: 儲存容量與產品庫存帳~Storage capacity and product inventory
units.mechanism: 裕廊是產品儲存而非洪水調蓄，教材扣除既有庫存與保留空間，另區分同溫體積帳與質量帳。岩洞總幾何容積不等於可裝產品量，既有庫存、保留氣相及不可使用區域都需扣除。液體熱膨脹與密度使體積帳和質量帳不同，轉運時還要處理管線存量；簡單差額只適用同一溫度、同一邊界與明確保留空間。~Jurong stores product rather than floods; subtract stock and reserve while distinguishing same-temperature volume from mass accounting. Gross cavern volume is not the amount available for product: existing stock, vapour reserve and unusable regions must be deducted. Thermal expansion and density distinguish volume from mass balances, while transfers involve pipeline inventory. A simple difference applies only at the same temperature, within one boundary and with explicitly reserved space.
units.model: 原創教學假設：總容積=100000 m³；既有庫存=67400 m³；保留空間=5000 m³。Vavailable=Vgross−Vstock−Vreserve=27600 m³。僅把既有庫存增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為20860 m³。邊界：假想同溫單室庫存帳，不是裕廊實際操作上限；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: gross volume=100000 m³; existing stock=67400 m³; reserve=5000 m³. Vavailable=Vgross−Vstock−Vreserve=27600 m³. Increasing only existing stock by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 20860 m³. Boundary: Hypothetical same-temperature cavern balance, not Jurong operating limits. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 配對液位容積表、溫度和密度，另列管線存量。以液位容積表、溫度與密度重建庫存，將管線轉運量和洞室量分開，再閉合進出質量帳。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Pair level-volume tables, temperature and density and list pipeline inventory separately. Reconstruct inventory from calibrated level-volume tables, temperature and density, separate pipeline and cavern volumes and close the inlet-outlet mass balance. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 把總幾何容積當可立即裝填量會漏掉氣相及保留空間。不同溫度的體積直接相減會產生假性損失，漏列氣相保留量則高估可用空間並扭曲排程。~Gross geometry as immediate filling capacity omits vapour and reserved space. Subtracting volumes at different temperatures creates apparent losses, while omitted vapour reserve overstates available space and distorts scheduling.
units.misconception: 總幾何容積減目前液位體積就是所有狀態的裝填上限。~Gross volume minus current liquid volume is the filling limit under every condition.
units.practice: 本案「可用庫存空間」的交付需回答：配對液位容積表、溫度和密度，另列管線存量。庫存交付明列溫度基準、保留空間和管線邊界，操作上限以核准設計與程序為準，教材差額僅供帳目理解。~For Jurong Rock Caverns, the available inventory space handover must address the following evidence: Pair level-volume tables, temperature and density and list pipeline inventory separately. Inventory records state temperature reference, reserved space and pipeline boundary; approved design and procedures determine operating limits, while the classroom difference illustrates accounting.

units.title: 控制網與貫通誤差~Control network and breakthrough error
units.mechanism: 洞室與地面設備的共同高程直接影響靜壓比較，教材研究深部水準基準偏移的封存後果。長隧道的微小方向誤差會沿距離累積，地下控制網又缺少直接衛星定位，必須把地表基準可靠傳到洞內。閉合差很小不代表無系統誤差；尺度、折光、儀器定向與高程基準可能共同偏移，誤差相關性也使平方和估算失真。~A shared elevation datum between cavern and surface equipment directly affects pressure comparison; examine consequences of deep benchmark bias. Small orientation errors accumulate over long drives, while underground networks lack direct satellite positioning and depend on transferring surface control. A small closure does not exclude systematic bias: scale, refraction, orientation and vertical datum may shift together. Correlated errors also invalidate a naive root-sum-square combination of supposedly independent observations.
units.model: 原創教學假設：控制長度=5880 m；方向偏角=2.7 arcsec。e=Lθπ/(180×3600)=0.076969 m。僅把方向偏角增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為0.0846659 m。邊界：小角度方向偏差，未加入控制網相關性及折光；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: control length=5880 m; orientation error=2.7 arcsec. e=Lθπ/(180×3600)=0.076969 m. Increasing only orientation error by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 0.0846659 m. Boundary: Small-angle orientation error without network correlation or refraction. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 以獨立水準路線核對液位與測壓管口高程。由獨立測量組複核地表到洞內的轉換，保留原始角距及溫度資料，用不同控制線比較方向與高程偏差。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Independently level liquid references and piezometer collars. Independently check surface-to-tunnel transformations, retain raw angles, distances and temperatures, and compare orientation and elevation through separate control routes. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 同一高程錯誤可能讓液位和水頭各自合理但壓差算錯。共用錯誤基準可能讓兩組測量同時看似一致，直到貫通或軌道銜接才發現系統偏差，修正成本遠高於早期複核。~One datum error can make separate levels plausible while the pressure difference is wrong. A shared wrong datum can make separate surveys appear consistent until breakthrough or track connection exposes bias that is costly to correct.
units.misconception: 兩次閉合結果一致就能證明地下控制網沒有系統誤差。~Two matching closures prove that an underground network has no systematic error.
units.practice: 本案「方向角誤差」的交付需回答：以獨立水準路線核對液位與測壓管口高程。貫通前凍結座標、尺度與高程版本，獨立組直接使用原始觀測重算；不得只傳遞整理好的坐標而遺失校正資訊。~For Jurong Rock Caverns, the orientation error handover must address the following evidence: Independently level liquid references and piezometer collars. Freeze coordinate, scale and height revisions before breakthrough; independent reviewers recompute raw observations rather than receiving only adjusted coordinates without corrections.

units.title: 水量帳與環境受體~Water balance and environmental receptors
units.mechanism: 儲存岩洞周圍水量帳需分開補注、滲入和產品管線範圍，教材不以水量殘差直接宣稱產品洩漏。隧道排水可能改變泉水、溪流或地下水補注，但同時還有降雨、季節與既有抽水等影響。水量平衡需要明確時間和空間邊界，殘差不能直接歸因於某一裂隙；應用施工前基線和對照站區分自然變化與工程效應。~Separate recharge, water ingress and product-pipeline boundaries; a water-balance residual is not direct proof of product leakage. Tunnel drainage may alter springs, streams or groundwater recharge, alongside rainfall, seasonal change and existing abstraction. A water balance needs explicit temporal and spatial boundaries; its residual cannot be assigned directly to one fracture. Baseline observations and control locations help separate natural variability from construction effects rather than equating correlation with causation.
units.model: 原創教學假設：流入=172 m³/day；流出=78 m³/day；其他損失=20 m³/day。ΔS=I−O−loss=74 m³/day。僅把流入增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為91.2 m³/day。邊界：指定邊界日水量帳，不是因果或含水層參數證明；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: inflow=172 m³/day; outflow=78 m³/day; other loss=20 m³/day. ΔS=I−O−loss=74 m³/day. Increasing only inflow by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 91.2 m³/day. Boundary: Daily balance in a stated boundary, not causal proof or aquifer-parameter identification. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 以水位、水量與獨立品質檢測交叉判讀，保留缺測。同步比較雨量、泉流、排水與對照井，核對儀器缺測和蓄水變化，對不同季節分別閉合水量帳。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Combine level, flow and independent quality evidence while preserving data gaps. Compare rainfall, spring flow, drainage and control wells, checking missing data and storage change and closing balances separately by season. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 未量測的地下水支路可能造成殘差，不能單憑差額定因。未量到的支流或時間錯位會產生假性水量損失，錯把所有減流歸於隧道可能導致無效補救。~Unmeasured groundwater branches create residuals that cannot alone identify cause. Unmeasured tributaries or timing mismatch create false losses; attributing every decrease to the tunnel can prompt ineffective mitigation.
units.misconception: 施工後泉水變少就能單獨證明隧道造成全部減流。~Reduced spring flow after construction alone proves the tunnel caused the entire change.
units.practice: 本案「邊界水量差」的交付需回答：以水位、水量與獨立品質檢測交叉判讀，保留缺測。預先定義受體、基線及資料缺口，任何因果判斷都需列出替代解釋，補救效果也用同一監測邊界評估。~For Jurong Rock Caverns, the boundary water-balance residual handover must address the following evidence: Combine level, flow and independent quality evidence while preserving data gaps. Define receptors, baselines and data gaps beforehand; causal judgements list alternatives, and mitigation is evaluated within the same monitoring boundary.

units.title: 資產編碼與可追溯交接~Asset identity and traceable handover
units.mechanism: 產品儲存設備與岩體監測必須連接位置及狀態，教材把產品庫存表、測壓和支護檢查放在同一可追溯鏈。地下設備的竣工資料必須讓維護人員找到正確位置、材料批次和控制版本。只有上傳圖面而沒有變更歷程，無法分辨元件替換與真正劣化；告警、儀器、線路及工單使用一致識別碼，才可能把量測趨勢連回實際受力或水力系統。~Link product-system records and rock monitoring by location and state, connecting inventory, pressure and support inspections traceably. Handover must let maintainers find the correct location, material batch and control revision. Drawings without change history cannot distinguish replacement from deterioration. Consistent identifiers across alarms, instruments, circuits and work orders are essential for linking trends to the physical structural or hydraulic system instead of treating each record as an isolated file.
units.model: 原創教學假設：設備總數=124 個；缺紀錄數=16 個。coverage=100(N−missing)/N=87.0968 %。僅把缺紀錄數增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為85.8065 %。邊界：資料完整度，不等於安全或可靠度；擾動為連續敏感度，實際個數為整數；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: asset count=124 count; missing records=16 count. coverage=100(N−missing)/N=87.0968 %. Increasing only missing records by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 85.8065 %. Boundary: Record completeness, not safety or reliability; perturbation is continuous sensitivity while actual counts are integers. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 抽查某洞室異常可否回查操作狀態、感測校正和地質。抽取一條告警，從控制畫面追到設備、線路、圖面和工單，核對位置、版本及校正日期並記錄無法閉合的欄位。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Trace a cavern anomaly to operating state, sensor calibration and geology. Trace a sampled alarm from screen to equipment, circuit, drawing and work order, checking location, revision and calibration dates and recording broken links. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 只看單一儀表趨勢而缺操作狀態會把正常轉運當異常滲流。設備改名卻未更新控制畫面會引導人員隔離錯誤回路，材料批次缺漏則使同批缺陷無法追蹤到其他位置。~One instrument trend without operating context can misclassify normal transfer as abnormal seepage. Renaming an asset without updating the screen can isolate the wrong circuit; missing material batches prevent tracing related defects at other locations.
units.misconception: 全部檔案上傳完成就代表工程交接已經驗收合格。~Uploading all files means that engineering handover has been accepted.
units.practice: 本案「資產資料完整度」的交付需回答：抽查某洞室異常可否回查操作狀態、感測校正和地質。交接以可完成的定位、查找與復原任務驗證，由維護責任人確認現場可用性；完整度只是資料指標，不代表結構安全或設備可靠。~For Jurong Rock Caverns, the asset-record completeness handover must address the following evidence: Trace a cavern anomaly to operating state, sensor calibration and geology. Validate handover through achievable location, retrieval and recovery tasks witnessed by maintainers; completeness measures records, not structural safety or equipment reliability.

example: 原創綜合審查：先計算「岩洞節理楔體與錨固」，再獨立計算「水力封存與共同高程」。原創教學假設：岩塊體積=36 m³；岩體單位重=26 kN/m³；分擔構件數=6 個。T=γV/N=156 kN/anchor。僅把岩塊體積增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為171.6 kN/anchor。邊界：僅自重均分量級，未含節理滑移、錨角及設計係數；不是本工程實測或允收值。原創教學假設：外側水密度=1000 kg/m³；外側水頭=40 m；產品密度=800 kg/m³；產品液柱=25 m；氣相表壓=20 kPa。Δp=(ρwghw−ρpghp)/1000−pgas, g=9.81 m/s²=176.2 kPa。僅把外側水頭增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為215.44 kPa。邊界：同一高程假想靜壓差，正值只顯示局部向內梯度，不證明全洞室封存；不是本工程實測或允收值。兩組結果的單位與邊界不同，不能直接相加。請列出一項缺少的現場輸入，說明它會影響哪個結論，以及哪種獨立量測可以縮小不確定度。~Original integrated review: first calculate cavern wedges and anchorage, then independently calculate hydraulic containment at a common datum. Original teaching assumptions: block volume=36 m³; unit weight=26 kN/m³; sharing anchors=6 count. T=γV/N=156 kN/anchor. Increasing only block volume by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 171.6 kN/anchor. Boundary: Equal self-weight sharing only, excluding sliding, anchor angle and design factors. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Original teaching assumptions: external water density=1000 kg/m³; external head=40 m; product density=800 kg/m³; product head=25 m; gas gauge pressure=20 kPa. Δp=(ρwghw−ρpghp)/1000−pgas, g=9.81 m/s²=176.2 kPa. Increasing only external head by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 215.44 kPa. Boundary: Hypothetical pressure difference at one elevation; positive means local inward gradient, not whole-cavern containment. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. The outputs have different units and boundaries and cannot simply be added. Identify one missing field input, explain which conclusion it changes and select an independent measurement to reduce uncertainty.
history: 2014 年公開記錄：裕廊岩洞儲存設施於9月正式開幕。JTC公開介紹裕廊岩洞可儲存147萬立方公尺液態碳氫產品，並將地下深度與海床下深度分開；2014年開幕有總理公署紀錄。本課從土地介面、岩體節理與支護開始，進入水力封存、產品庫存及監測交付。幾何面積、局部壓差和假想庫存都不等於實際土地效益或操作上限。本課把「岩洞楔體、水力封存與產品庫存」視為互相連動的系統，工程年代和名稱由所列公開來源核對；模型中的設備配置、荷載與量測數字另外標明為教學假設，只重建公開原理及工程推理，不是原始設計文件。~Public record for 2014: Jurong Rock Caverns storage facility officially opens in September. JTC describes 1.47 million cubic metres of liquid-hydrocarbon storage and distinguishes depth below ground from depth beneath the seabed; the PMO records the 2014 opening. The course moves from land interfaces and jointed rock to support, hydraulic containment, inventory and monitoring. Geometric area, local pressure difference and hypothetical inventory are not actual land savings or operating limits. The course treats cavern wedges, hydraulic containment and product inventory as coupled engineering questions. Named events and dimensions follow the listed public sources; equipment scenarios, loads and measurement values are separately marked teaching assumptions. Only public principles and reasoning are reconstructed, not original design documents.
facts: 公開工程尺度約為 1.47 million m³ storage capacity，保留所列來源的計量邊界。~The public scale is about 1.47 million m³ storage capacity; retain the measurement boundary in the cited source.
2014 年事件：裕廊岩洞儲存設施於9月正式開幕。~2014 event: Jurong Rock Caverns storage facility officially opens in September.

教學「幾何等效面積」：儲存容積=100000 m³，其餘輸入依單元，結果=5000 m²；不是實測或允收值。~Teaching geometric equivalent area: storage volume=100000 m³, with remaining inputs as in the unit, gives 5000 m²; not measured or accepted project data.

教學「楔體重力分擔」：岩塊體積=36 m³，其餘輸入依單元，結果=156 kN/anchor；不是實測或允收值。~Teaching wedge self-weight sharing: block volume=36 m³, with remaining inputs as in the unit, gives 156 kN/anchor; not measured or accepted project data.

教學「測壓水頭」：水密度=1000 kg/m³，其餘輸入依單元，結果=1275.3 kPa；不是實測或允收值。~Teaching piezometric head: water density=1000 kg/m³, with remaining inputs as in the unit, gives 1275.3 kPa; not measured or accepted project data.

教學「局部向內壓差」：外側水密度=1000 kg/m³，其餘輸入依單元，結果=176.2 kPa；不是實測或允收值。~Teaching local inward pressure difference: external water density=1000 kg/m³, with remaining inputs as in the unit, gives 176.2 kPa; not measured or accepted project data.
